calculate_precision_recall: calculate precision and recall for bounding box predictions against reference boxes with configurable IoU threshold
calculate_mean_coverage: calculate mean coverage score between predicted and reference bounding boxes
match_bounding_boxes: match predicted bounding boxes to reference boxes using IoU-based greedy assignment
calculate_iou: calculate intersection-over-union between two bounding boxes for overlap measurement
calculate_rank_accuracy: calculate rank accuracy between predicted and reference bounding box scores
